limitations.detail: A4 freezes same-user local-process trust; no individual caller authentication or hostile same-user-process isolation is claimed.
A2 does not claim immunity to a hostile same-user process changing filesystem state after checks.
A4 governs TW-Market control-plane authority; it does not claim to control downstream model cognition.
A5 does not claim cryptographic provenance of OS/Python/Git binaries or online vulnerability freshness.
A6 freezes memory hard runtime kill threshold as NOT_USED and relies on structural bounds plus long-horizon acceptance.
A6 freezes whole-server global hard deadline as NOT_USED_BY_DESIGN; active network/action execution envelopes are finite.
A6 resource-intensive concurrency ceiling 1 is per app process; no cross-process coordinator is claimed.
Governed Watchlist/evidence history is not automatically truncated; each new persistent write is subject to dynamic disk admission.
Two TG4 historical Mode C nodes remain KNOWN_HISTORICAL_REPLAY_GAP_NOT_CURRENT_PROTECTION; governed deselected, unrepaired, not represented as passing.
Seven hash-bound historical memory-evidence JSON artifacts retain one EOF CRCRLF each; exception-aware candidate diff check is clean and no generic whitespace waiver exists.
